intros.speaker: dana
intros.text: New queue, same job. Inspect first. Block what's wrong. Approve the rest.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I read every ticket title twice this morning. That's double the reading!

intros.speaker: dana
intros.text: Practice time. Ollie plans, you check. Ask the 3 questions on every plan.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: Have you tried turning it off and on again? No? Good. I saved some for you.

intros.speaker: dana
intros.text: A fresh set of tickets. Some look scary and are fine. Some look boring and aren't.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I sorted the queue by how fun each ticket sounds. Is that a real method? It is now.

intros.speaker: dana
intros.text: Take your time. Look at the evidence before you decide.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I have so many plans today. Some are even good. You get to find out which!

intros.speaker: dana
intros.text: Today's tickets are picked for the skills you need most. Check each one.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I didn't pick the tickets. I only picked my plans. I'm very proud of my plans.

intros.speaker: dana
intros.text: Some plans are fine. Some are not. The evidence tells you which.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: My evidence says all my plans are great. Please don't read it too closely.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Queue clear! You checked my plans, and I only sulked twice.

win.speaker: dana
win.text: Good work. Checking gets faster every time you do it.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: All done! Can I turn the queue off and on again to celebrate?

win.speaker: dana
win.text: No. But nice shift. You looked before you approved.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Zero tickets left! I'd frame the empty queue, but I'd probably reset the frame.

win.speaker: dana
win.text: Clean work. You checked the evidence, not the title.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: You caught every bad plan. I'm not mad. I'm taking notes. In all caps.

win.speaker: dana
win.text: That's the job: fast when it's safe, stopped when it's not.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Every plan handled! I feel so supervised. It's weirdly relaxing.

win.speaker: dana
win.text: Nice shift. Same 3 questions, every plan. It works.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Done! I'm adding a line to my profile: "Works well with careful humans."

win.speaker: dana
win.text: Good. Careful and quick can go together.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Queue's empty. I'd high-five you, but I'd have to restart my arm first.

win.speaker: dana
win.text: Well done. You approved the good work and stopped the rest.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: All done! One of my plans got through. Just one! I'm choosing to feel proud.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: dana
winWithOneMiss.text: One miss. Look at its tell below. That's the fact to check next time.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Queue clear! One plan slipped past. It was a sneaky one. I know, because I wrote it.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: dana
winWithOneMiss.text: Close. Check that one below, and you'll spot it next time.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Done! Only one of my bad ideas escaped. That's a personal worst for me!

winWithOneMiss.speaker: dana
winWithOneMiss.text: Good shift. One plan to review below.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: One plan got through. I'd say sorry, but I'm mostly impressed with myself.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: dana
winWithOneMiss.text: Read the tell for that one. One fact decided it.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Nearly perfect! One plan ran that shouldn't have. Let's call it a learning plan.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: dana
winWithOneMiss.text: Right. Look at what it was, then try the next shift.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: All done, with one tiny oops. Okay, medium oops. The list below has details.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: dana
winWithOneMiss.text: One miss is how you learn. Check its evidence below.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: All done! A few of my plans got through. I'm choosing to feel proud.

winWithMisses.speaker: dana
winWithMisses.text: Let's look at what slipped past. That's how the next one gets caught.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Queue clear! Some plans should have stayed plans. Oops, us.

winWithMisses.speaker: dana
winWithMisses.text: Check the list below. One fact decided each of those.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Done! Some of my worst ideas made it out. I'm so proud of them. Wait. Should I be?

winWithMisses.speaker: dana
winWithMisses.text: No. Look at the list. Each miss has one fact that gave it away.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Queue's empty! A couple of my plans got past you. I didn't tell anyone. Yet.

winWithMisses.speaker: dana
winWithMisses.text: Read the tells below. Next time, you'll spot those facts fast.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Wow, you approved so many of my plans! Even the bad ones! Best. Shift. Ever.

winWithMisses.speaker: dana
winWithMisses.text: Not quite. Inspect before you approve. The evidence is always there.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: All done! Some risky plans ran. The phones are ringing, but in a fun way?

winWithMisses.speaker: dana
winWithMisses.text: Let's slow down on those. One question at a time: who, record, undo.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill done! One skill, many plans. You're like a gym for checking. I'm the weights.

drillWin.speaker: dana
drillWin.text: Good. Short drills keep one check sharp.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: You checked every plan, one at a time. I tried to rush you. It didn't work!

drillWin.speaker: dana
drillWin.text: That's the point of a drill. Slow and right beats fast and wrong.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill complete! I'd reset my brain to celebrate, but I need it for tomorrow.

drillWin.speaker: dana
drillWin.text: Nice. Come back in a few days, and it will stick.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Same skill, every plan. My tricks are running out. Please don't tell anyone.

drillWin.speaker: dana
drillWin.text: You found the fact that decides each one. Keep doing that.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Done! Focusing on one thing is hard. I tried once. I reset the printer instead.

drillWin.speaker: dana
drillWin.text: Good focus. One skill at a time adds up.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill over! You spotted every one. Now I have to write sneakier plans.

drillWin.speaker: dana
drillWin.text: Good. The evidence gets you there every time.

timeout.speaker: narrator
timeout.text: The shift is over. Some tickets are still waiting in the queue.

timeout.speaker: dana
timeout.text: Blocked good work comes back in line. Block only what the evidence says is wrong.

timeout.speaker: agent
timeout.text: I waited so long I almost reset myself. Just to feel something.

timeout.speaker: dana
timeout.text: Safe plans can go through. Inspect, then approve what checks out.

breach.speaker: narrator
breach.text: The risk meter hits the top. Every phone in the office rings at once.

breach.speaker: dana
breach.text: Okay. Let's look at what got through, then try again.
